hats.config.mobs.toggle.tooltip: Allow this mob to spawn with a hat
hats.config.mobs.bossLocked.tooltip: Turn on Boss Mobs in the General tab to allow hats on this boss.
hats.config.hatStandGuiStyle.tooltip: Choose the Hat Stand menu style independently from the player Hats menu.
hats.config.mobHatTakeover.tooltip: When a hatless mob kills a hatted mob, the killer inherits the hat.
hats.config.bossMobHats.tooltip: When on, ender dragons, withers, elder guardians, and wardens can spawn with hats. Turn off to stop those bosses spawning hatted. On by default.
hats.config.preventUndeadFire.tooltip: When on, undead mobs wearing a hat do not burn in sunlight. Off by default.
hats.config.disableContributorHats.toolt: When on, (C) contributor hats are excluded from random mob hat spawns. Already worn hats are left alone. Off by default.
hats.config.hatLauncherReplacesPlayerHat: Launched hats can knock a hat off another player.
hats.config.hatLauncherKeepsInventoryHat: When a launched hat hits a player, keep their previous hat in inventory.
hats.config.hatUnlockAnnouncement.toolti: Tell every player in chat when someone unlocks a hat for the first time. The name is colored by rarity. Off by default.
